text:
maya: seeing p95 spike in us-west around 06:04 UTC. latency jumped ~3x for short-sequence workloads. selector logs look like a bunch of requests were routed to the heavy AVX kernel instead of the fast smallseq path. cc @liam @chandra
liam: looking now. profiler shows kernel_selection.thin_heavy count spike at 06:03:57. attaching tail of selector log for context:
```
[06:03:57] selector: req=abcd1234 seq_len=12 preferred=smallseq fallback=avx_heavy selected=avx_heavy score=0.67
[06:03:57] selector: req=efgh5678 seq_len=8 preferred=smallseq fallback=avx_heavy selected=avx_heavy score=0.59
```
liam: score thresholds seem to have drifted after recent autoscaling change.
chandra: KV cache evictions spiked too — short sequences are thrashing prefixes. evictions/sec ~4x baseline. likely noisy tenant causing churn.
devon: confirmed noisy tenant id=tenant-42 traffic pattern: many 5-20 token requests bursty. @@tenant-42 had a bot replay test at ~06:03.
janet: ops suggestion: flip throttle feature flag for tenant-42 to reduce QPS and enable immediate fallback routing to quantized-compat model. also set selector backoff multiplier to 3x to prefer smallseq kernel while we investigate.
devon: applying flag now: `feature.tenant_throttle.tenant-42 = on` -> done :white_check_mark:
sre-bot: deploy queued: routing-change-v0.3 -> applied to us-west pool (hash ring update id=rr-2026-06-14-06).
incident-bot: incident created: INC-20260614-rtp1. Status: mitigations applied (tenant throttle + fallback route).
maya: after throttle/fallback, p95 dropped ~40% within 45s. still above baseline but improving.
liam: digging selector scoring model — suspect the recent kernel scoring tweak increased weight on throughput for short windows; will revert that commit on canary and run perf probe.
chandra: adding shortseq-specific KV cache guard: limit prefix caching for sequences <24 tokens to avoid polluting main cache. opened ticket: INF-742 (shortseq-kvcache-guard).
janet: I'll keep tenant throttle for 2 hours then reassess. also pushing customer comms to CS for tenant-42.
devon: added temporary route rule: any requests with tenant=tenant-42 -> quantized-compat fallback model in us-west.
liam: can we get flameprof snapshot from the heavy kernel when probe fires? helps confirm CPU hotspots.
maya: uploaded flameprof link: https://internal.redwood/prof/ff/2176543210/trace1
liam: confirmed hotloop in attention kernel for seq_len<=20 when executed on avx_heavy. Looks like a vectorization mismatch.
chandra: long term: tweak selector to include seq_len histogram window and sticky kernel hints per shard to avoid oscillation. will prototype next sprint.
maya: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as timeline. will update once INF-742 and selector revert are scheduled. :thumbsup:
